question: In a certain language, SACHIN is written as 19138914. How will GEETA be written as in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/faa05794c535d8e3847a5c4e36c56250adadd16270c20615e138f6b6d410bf57.png] 

The logic followed here is: **Letter coded by its place value.**

SACHIN is written as 19138914

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e0a8fbebc2a085c6897e5881db7f0039a94d26c80025b6ca416da2065cc2964c.png] 

Similarly, GEETA will be written as:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/95d09a9e8aab4849a4299078a3cc9978cc48d72d219dd3aacffbd659792cb534.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"****755201".**
